_doc: ZIP pages taken off the live site. Two groups share ONE list, 'zips', which every reader uses (shell.js: every page shows a noindex 'not available' notice for these ZIPs instead of drawing them; scripts/gen_zip_pages.py: no /community/<zip>/ document, no sitemap entry, no sibling/city/project link; scripts/gen_sitemap.py). (1) The 47 ZIPs the pinned ZIP dataset lists as decommissioned (founder, 2026-10-01: 'retire the 47 zip code pages, take them off live site until i can investigate further'); their provenance is source / source_class / source_md5 below. (2) ZIPs whose existence is UNVERIFIED (founder, 2026-10-03), described one by one in 'unverified'. An unverified ZIP is NOT claimed retired, invalid, decommissioned or active, and the shell's notice for it says only that we could not confirm it. 'page_action' in 'unverified' is the recorded classification label; the behaviour is the same existing notice for both groups, with no redirect to any other ZIP, city, county or place. Nothing is deleted and canonical_zip_registry is not touched. To put a ZIP back, move it from 'zips' to 'restored' (and, for an unverified ZIP, only after USPS or USPS City State Product verification). Pinned by test/withheld-zip-pages.test.mjs and test/withheld-zip-pages.browser.test.mjs.
reason: Applies to the 47 ZIPs in class DECOMMISSIONED_IN_DATASET only: listed as decommissioned (retired) in the pinned ZIP dataset, zipcodes 3.0.0 (data from unitedstateszipcodes.org, not checked against USPS). Fix 4 class DECOMMISSIONED_IN_DATASET. It is not the reason for the ZIPs in 'unverified'.
unverified_reason: Existence not established: USPS lookup could not be performed, and the ZIP is absent from zipcodes 3.0.0 and the Census 2010/2020 ZCTA datasets (Fix 4 class NOT_IN_ZIP_DATASET). Not classified as invalid, retired, decommissioned or geographic.
